lore_anchors.definition: One of the Ten Elder Gods of the primordial Pangu world. His death in internal conflict led to the collapse of the Dragon race's dominance.
The Elder God of Metal, one of the Ten Elder Gods, who also perished in the primordial civil war.
The most terrifying Chaos alien ever encountered. A master of puppetry and Mother Queens who secretly orchestrated the collision of the two Chaosworlds for his own purposes.
The second most powerful being in the Seamless Chaosworld. He managed to escape from a Pangu-level Nuwa and bring the remnants of his people to safety.
The supreme ruler of the Seamless Chaosworld, whose power was nearly on par with Pangu. He was heavily injured by Nuwa and forced to flee.
The largest piece of wreckage left after the collision and shattering of the two primordial Chaosworlds. The remnants of the Lord of All Demons' army were sealed there.
A great power of the Three Realms who advocates for peace with the Seamless Gate, a view Subhuti scathingly dismisses as suicidal folly.
The life-or-death tribulation faced by a Fiendgod Body Refiner to transcend and become an Empyrean God, considered far more dangerous than a Heavenly Tribulation.
